decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-698bdca68108], is a one-line changelog entry that says mTLS support was added to the Memcached client and links to PR 12318. It doesn't name the configuration keys, flags or Helm values that enable mTLS. It doesn't say whether the feature is opt-in or changes any default. It doesn't say which Memcached-backed caches it covers. Without those details, nobody can write a declarative applicability condition. We need the PR or the configuration reference showing the new mTLS settings and their defaults.
